92	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
93	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
94	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
95	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
96	    """
97	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
98	    """
99	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
100	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
101	
102	    for i in range(n_bins):
103	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
104	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
105	        if mask.sum() > 0:
106	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
107	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
108	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
109	        else:
110	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
111	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
112	            bin_counts.append(0)
113	
114	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
115	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
116	
117	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
118	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
119	        sharex=True
120	    )
121	
122	    # 主图：gaps
123	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
124	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
125	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
126	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
127	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
128	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
129	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
130	    ax_main.set_title(title)
131	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
132	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
133	
134	    # ECE annotation
135	    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
136	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
137	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
138	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
139	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

## 1. Reliability Diagram（校准图）

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(datasets)))
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
    ax.set_title(title)

    cbar.set_label('ΔECE (quantized − FP16)')
```

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)
```

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import os

out_dir = '/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/paper/figures'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 8,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

# Professional muted color palette
C = {
    'bb_fill': '#DCEEFB', 'bb_edge': '#2171B5',
    'g1_fill': '#F5F5F5', 'g1_edge': '#757575',
    'g2_fill': '#E8F5E9', 'g2_edge': '#388E3C',
    'g3_fill': '#FFF8E1', 'g3_edge': '#E65100',
    's2_fill': '#EDE7F6', 's2_edge': '#5E35B1',
    'hi_edge': '#B71C1C', 'hi_fill': '#FFEBEE',
    'arr': '#444444',
    'txt': '#222222',
    'sub': '#777777',
}

W, H = 10, 20
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(3.35, 6.5))
ax = fig.add_axes([0.01, 0.01, 0.98, 0.98])
ax.set_xlim(0, W)
ax.set_ylim(0, H)
ax.axis('off')

# ─── Helpers ───
def rbox(cx, cy, w, h, label, fc='white', ec='black', fs=7, fw='normal',
         tc=C['txt'], lw=0.8, z=5):
    p = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                       boxstyle='round,pad=0.1',
                       fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(p)
    if label:
        ax.text(cx, cy, label, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
                fontweight=fw, color=tc, zorder=z + 1)

def darr(x1, y1, x2, y2, lw=0.7, color=None):
    c = color or C['arr']
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=lw))

def t(x, y, s, **kw):
    d = dict(ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5, color=C['sub'])
    d.update(kw)
    ax.text(x, y, s, **d)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
t(5, 19.4, 'Stage 1: Turn-Level Encoder Variants',
  fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', color=C['txt'])

# DeBERTa backbone
rbox(5, 18.5, 7.5, 0.65, 'DeBERTa-v3-base (pretrained)',
     C['bb_fill'], C['bb_edge'], fs=7.5, fw='bold')

# Tree branch
g1c, g2c, g3c = 1.8, 5.0, 8.2
branch_y = 17.85
ax.plot([5, 5], [18.15, branch_y], color=C['arr'], lw=0.8, zorder=3,
        solid_capstyle='round')
ax.plot([g1c, g3c], [branch_y, branch_y], color=C['arr'], lw=0.8, zorder=3,
        solid_capstyle='round')
for xc in [g1c, g2c, g3c]:
    darr(xc, branch_y, xc, 17.55)

# Group backgrounds
grp_top, grp_h = 17.5, 5.7
grp_bot = grp_top - grp_h
g1w, g2w, g3w = 2.8, 2.8, 3.0

for (gc, gw, fill, edge) in [(g1c, g1w, C['g1_fill'], C['g1_edge']),
                               (g2c, g2w, C['g2_fill'], C['g2_edge']),
                               (g3c, g3w, C['g3_fill'], C['g3_edge'])]:
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((gc - gw/2, grp_bot), gw, grp_h,
                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.12', fc=fill, ec=edge,
                        lw=0.5, ls='--', zorder=1)
    ax.add_patch(bg)

# ── Group 1: No Adaptation ──
t(g1c, 17.15, 'No Adaptation', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color=C['g1_edge'])
rbox(g1c, 16.1, 2.2, 0.7, 'vanilla', 'white', C['g1_edge'], fs=7)
t(g1c, 15.35, 'pretrained\nweights only', fontsize=6, style='italic', linespacing=1.1)

# ── Group 2: MLM Adaptation ──
t(g2c, 17.15, 'MLM Adaptation', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color=C['g2_edge'])
rbox(g2c, 16.1, 2.2, 0.7, 'JB-MLM', 'white', C['g2_edge'], fs=7)
t(g2c, 15.35, 'jailbreak text', fontsize=6, style='italic')
rbox(g2c, 14.5, 2.2, 0.7, 'wiki-MLM', 'white', C['g2_edge'], fs=7)
t(g2c, 13.75, 'Wikipedia (OOD ctrl)', fontsize=6, style='italic')

# ── Group 3: Classification ──
t(g3c, 17.15, 'Classification', fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold', color=C['g3_edge'])

rbox(g3c, 16.2, 2.4, 0.55, 'topic', 'white', C['g3_edge'], fs=7)
t(g3c, 15.7, 'topic clf (ctrl)', fontsize=5.5, style='italic')

rbox(g3c, 15.15, 2.4, 0.55, 'scrambled', 'white', C['g3_edge'], fs=7)
t(g3c, 14.65, '9-cls, shuffled labels', fontsize=5.5, style='italic')

rbox(g3c, 14.1, 2.4, 0.55, 'binary', 'white', C['g3_edge'], fs=7)
t(g3c, 13.6, 'presence + intent', fontsize=5.5, style='italic')

rbox(g3c, 12.95, 2.4, 0.65, '9-class', C['hi_fill'], C['hi_edge'], fs=7.5, fw='bold')
t(g3c, 12.35, '9 strategies + intent', fontsize=5.5, style='italic', color=C['hi_edge'])
t(g3c, 11.95, '(full treatment)', fontsize=5.5, fontweight='bold', color=C['hi_edge'])

# ── Separator ──
sep_y = 11.2
ax.plot([0.5, 9.5], [sep_y, sep_y], color='#BBBBBB', ls=':', lw=0.6, zorder=2)
darr(5, sep_y + 0.3, 5, sep_y + 0.05, lw=1.0, color=C['arr'])
t(5, sep_y - 0.35, 'Freeze encoder weights', 
  fontsize=7, fontweight='bold', color=C['arr'], style='italic')
darr(5, sep_y - 0.6, 5, sep_y - 0.85, lw=1.0, color=C['s2_edge'])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2
# ═══════════════════════════════════════
s2_top = 10.0
s2_bot = 4.8
s2_bg = FancyBboxPatch((0.5, s2_bot), 9, s2_top - s2_bot,
                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.15', fc=C['s2_fill'], ec=C['s2_edge'],
                        lw=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.add_patch(s2_bg)

t(5, 9.6, 'Stage 2: Multi-Turn Jailbreak Classifier',
  fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=C['s2_edge'])

# Per-turn [CLS] label
t(5, 9.0, 'Per-turn [CLS] from frozen encoder', fontsize=6.5, color=C['sub'])

# Turn [CLS] boxes
turn_y = 8.2
turns = [(2.2, '[CLS]$_1$'), (4.2, '[CLS]$_2$'), (7.8, '[CLS]$_K$')]
for tx, tl in turns:
    rbox(tx, turn_y, 1.5, 0.45, tl, 'white', C['s2_edge'], fs=7, lw=0.5)
t(6.0, turn_y, '...', fontsize=9, color=C['sub'])

# Arrows to BiGRU
bigru_y = 7.0
for tx, _ in turns:
    darr(tx, turn_y - 0.28, 5, bigru_y + 0.32)

# BiGRU
rbox(5, bigru_y, 5.8, 0.55, 'BiGRU  (2 layers, 256d, dropout 0.3)',
     'white', C['s2_edge'], fs=7, fw='bold')

# Arrow to output
darr(5, bigru_y - 0.33, 5, 6.0)

# Output
rbox(5, 5.6, 3.2, 0.55, 'Jailbreak / Benign',
     C['hi_fill'], C['hi_edge'], fs=7.5, fw='bold')

# K-prefix note
t(5, 5.0, 'Evaluate at K-prefix (early detection)',
  fontsize=6, style='italic')

# ── Save ──
for fmt in ['pdf', 'png']:
    fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig1_architecture.{fmt}', format=fmt)
    print(f'Saved: {out_dir}/fig1_architecture.{fmt}')
plt.close()
